title: Self-adjointness of the noise operator
statement:
Fix a dimension $n$ and let $f, g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be Boolean functions. For any real number $\rho$, the noise operator $T_\rho$ is self-adjoint with respect to the $L^2$ inner product induced by the uniform measure on $\{0,1\}^n$:
\[
  \langle T_\rho f, g\rangle \;=\; \langle f, T_\rho g\rangle.
\]
hypotheses_covered: two Boolean functions f, g of arity n
replaced:
